title: Expressive Twin-Words and Reduplications: gizgaz, limlom, csecsebecse, hercehurca

sections.title: Morphological Structure of Hungarian Twin-Words (Ikerszók)
sections.content: Hungarian features an exceptionally rich layer of expressive twin-words (ikerszók) and reduplicated stems. These words are created either through rhyming (rímelő ikerszók) where the initial consonant alters while the vowel core remains identical ('gizgaz', 'limlom', 'hercehurca', 'csecsebecse'), or through vowel alternation (ablaut or tőbelseji magánhangzó-váltakozás) where the consonants remain stable while the vowel alternates between front and back ('csihi-puhi', 'dirib-darab', 'ingó-bingó').

sections.title: Discourse Functions and Suffixation Rules
sections.content: Twin-words infuse Hungarian speech with expressive, diminutive, or mildly derogatory nuances. When twin-words are written as a single hyphenated or compound noun, inflectional suffixes attach solely to the second stem: 'limlomot', 'csecsebecsékkel', 'hercehurcát'. Adverbial twin-words express attitude or manner: 'ímmel-ámmal' signifies doing something half-heartedly, grudgingly, or without genuine enthusiasm.

sections.title: Core Hungarian Expressive Twin-Words
rows: A kert végében teljesen elszaporodott a gizgaz. (The scrub and weeds grew wildly.)
Hétvégén kidobjuk a pincéből a felgyülemlett limlomot. (We will throw out the accumulated junk.)
Csillogó csecsebecsékkel díszítették fel a polcokat. (They decorated the shelves with trinkets.)
Végre véget ért az adóbevallással járó sok hercehurca. (Finally the hassle of the tax return ended.)
Csak ímmel-ámmal fogott hozzá a takarításhoz. (He started cleaning only half-heartedly.)

items.spanish: Az elhagyatott gyárudvart az évek során teljesen felverte a szúrós gizgaz.
items.english: Over the years, the abandoned factory yard was completely overgrown with prickly weeds.

items.spanish: Mielőtt az új lakásba költöznénk, meg kell szabadulnunk a felesleges limlomtól.
items.english: Before moving into the new apartment, we must get rid of the unnecessary junk.

items.spanish: A bazárban rengeteg színes csecsebecsét kínáltak a turistáknak.
items.english: In the bazaar, they offered heaps of colorful trinkets to the tourists.

items.spanish: A bürokratikus hercehurca miatt hónapokat késett az építkezés megkezdése.
items.english: Due to the bureaucratic hassle, the start of construction was delayed by months.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Remember that compound twin-words inflect only on their second part in contemporary Hungarian: 'limlomot gyűjt', 'csecsebecsékért rajong'. Do not inflect both elements unless dealing with fixed historical adverbs such as 'ímmel-ámmal'.
